$description: Component sizes. The diagram layout reads these at runtime, so CSS and layout can never disagree. Vertical sizes are multiples of grid.unit.

head-height.$description: padding-y + overline line + heading line + padding-y = 8 + 16 + 24 + 8

gutter.$description: Width of the change mark column

kind.$description: Width of the member kind column

stripe.$description: Status stripe on the card's leading edge

layer-gap.$description: Horizontal space between columns of cards

node-gap.$description: Vertical space between cards in a column

edge-gap.$description: Space between an arrowhead and the card it points at

arrow-length.$description: Tip to back corners of an arrowhead at normal weight

arrow-width.$description: Width across the back of an arrowhead

arrow-notch.$description: How far back the notch sits, as a share of arrow-length; lines end here

arrow-scale-strong.$description: Arrowhead scale for emphasised edges, matching edge-width-strong

dot.$description: Radius of a canvas grid dot

dash-inferred.$description: Dash pattern for edges not resolved from the code

dash-data.$description: Dash pattern for reads and writes

dash-flow.$description: Dash pattern for the animated flow path

dash-flow-period.$description: Sum of dash-flow; the animation moves by one period
